sam: Quick readout from VerdantPrime POC run — ran a mixed chat/embeds profile (60/40) to mirror their peak. dropping config + topline.

leila: paste config + short numbers, we need to update the quote.

sam: config: model=redwood-13b-8k-quant, infra=dedicated-2xA100, concurrency target=160, batch_target=14, kv_cache=enabled, prefix_prewarm=off (baseline). runner=k6 with poisson arrivals + 25s microbursts to 240 qps.

omar: requirement was p95 < 400ms for chat, right?

sam: yes. baseline 40m soak results: sustained 120 qps achieved; chat p50=260ms, p95=710ms; embeddings p95=190ms; burst error rate=4.5%; GPU util avg=70%; mem headroom ~9GB. hosted-equivalent cost estimate ~$0.67/1k chat tokens.

leila: 710ms p95 is a problem. root cause?

sam: short list: ingress queueing during bursts, several long tail kernel stalls on two workers, and prefix-cache cold misses for less common prompts.

ogram: (typo) omar: options to hit 400ms p95 — quick vs engineering?

sam: quick fixes: 1) enable prefix_prewarm for top-150 prompts, 2) reduce batch_target to 12 during burst windows, 3) enable short-lived burst worker (+1) when qps>150. Low effort.

ops-bot: [automated] autoscale suggestion created: RB-88421 by sam. policy +1 worker when 1m avg qps >150, cooldown 3m. link: https://console.redwood.example/rb/88421

leila: please run primed + batch=12 experiment and capture CSV. we present that as recommended baseline; kernel tuning stays optional.

sam: running now. snippet used for chat runner:
```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat', JSON.stringify({model:'redwood-13b-8k-quant',prompt:'Summarize briefly',max_tokens:150}), {headers:{Authorization:'Bearer REDACTED'}});
  sleep(Math.random()*0.12);
}
```
ops-bot: deploy job started (RB-88421) by sam at 3259876560

sam: follow-up (3259876592) after primed run (20m focused on bursts): chat p95 dropped to 395ms (within target), p50=245ms, embeddings p95=175ms, burst drop rate down to 0.8%, incremental burst buffer cost estimate +$1.9k/mo. uploaded perf ZIP: https://drive.redwood.example/verdantprime/perf/3259876543-report.zip

leila: perfect. we'll present priming + burst buffer as the baseline; include optional eng-runtime tuning retainer ($5k) if they want further tail reduction.

omar: also answer their KMS/audit Q: for Private we support customer-managed KMS; for Dedicated we offer envelope encryption + audit export to SIEM on request. will draft 2-3 lines.

sam: closing loop — will attach CSV + flame graphs to the proposal and update the SOW. :white_check_mark:
